svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: var(--ge-adaptive-bg, #ffffff); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="Q4m6HTVAL2Lb-pLERglT" name="Page-2"> <mxGraphModel dx="2613" dy="2274" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
title Traffic Signal Controller 
actor \"Life Cycle Manager\" as LC
actor \"Traffic Decision Engine\" as A
participant \"Health Reporter\" as HR
participant \"Plan Receiver\" as PR
participant \"Signal FSM Engine\" as FSM 
participant \"Output Simulator\" as OS
participant \"Publisher Collector\" as PC
participant \"Logger\" 
participant \"Analytics\"
actor \"Traffic Participants\" as TP

A -> PR : TimingPlan 
activate A
activate PR
PR -> PR : validPlan()
activate PR
PR -->> PR : validPlanResult
deactivate PR
alt plan invalid 
 PR -> PR: reject()
 activate PR
 PR -->> PR : rejectResult
 deactivate PR
 PR -->> A : N A C K
else plan valid
 PR -> PR : accept()
 activate PR
 PR -->> PR : acceptResult
 deactivate PR
 PR -->> A : A C K
 deactivate A
 PR -> FSM : PlanData(newPlan)
end
deactivate PR

loop tick_due == 1
 FSM -> FSM : waitTick()
 activate FSM
 alt emergency plan
 FSM -> FSM : updatePlan()
 activate FSM
 FSM -->> FSM : planUpdated
 deactivate FSM
 else no emergency plan
 alt remaining time > 0 
 FSM -> FSM : keepState()
 activate FSM
 FSM -->> FSM : stateKept
 deactivate FSM
 else remaining time == 0
 alt new plan available
 FSM -> FSM : updatePlan()
 activate FSM
 FSM -->> FSM : planUpdated
 deactivate FSM
 else no new plan
 note right: keep current plan
 end
 end
 end
 FSM -> FSM : fsm()
 activate FSM
 FSM -->> FSM : fsmResult
 deactivate FSM
 FSM ->> PC : SignalOutput
 activate PC
 FSM ->> OS : SignalDisplay
 deactivate FSM
 activate OS
 PC -> PC : collectTimestamp()
 activate PC
 PC -->> PC : timestampCollected
 deactivate PC
 opt cycle completed 
 PC -> PC : packageData()
 activate PC
 PC -->> PC : dataPackaged
 deactivate PC
 PC -> B : DataCollect
 activate B
 deactivate B
 end
 deactivate PC
 OS -> OS : formatConsole()
 activate OS
 OS -->> OS : consoleFormatted
 deactivate OS
 activate TP
 OS -> TP : Console
 deactivate TP
 deactivate OS
end
loop heartbeat_due == 1
 LC -> HR : HeartbeatRequest
 activate LC
 activate HR
 HR ->> Timer : requestHeartbeat()
 activate Timer
 Timer -->> HR : Heartbeat
 deactivate Timer
 HR ->> FSM : requestHeartbeat()
 activate FSM
 FSM -->> HR : Heartbeat
 deactivate FSM
 HR ->> PC : requestHeartbeat()
 activate PC
 PC -->> HR : Heartbeat
 deactivate PC
 HR -> HR : evaluateHealth()
 activate HR
 HR -->> HR : healthEvaluated
 deactivate HR
 HR -->> LC : HealthReport
 deactivate HR
 deactivate LC
end
opt command received 
 LC -> HR : LifecycleCommand(command)
 activate LC
 activate HR
 HR -> HR : processCommand()
 activate HR
 HR -->> HR : commandProcessed
 deactivate HR
 HR ->> PR : command
 activate PR
 PR -->> HR : status 
 deactivate PR
 HR ->> Timer : command
 activate Timer
 Timer -->> HR : status 
 deactivate Timer
 HR ->> FSM : command
 activate FSM
 FSM -->> HR : status 
 deactivate FSM
 HR ->> PC : command
 activate PC
 PC -->> HR : status 
 deactivate PC
 HR ->> OS : command
 activate OS
 OS -->> HR : status 
 deactivate OS
 HR -->> LC : ACK(commandDone)
 deactivate HR
 deactivate LC
end
@enduml ",
